_owner: PB (planet and field NPCs): miners, fishers, the jungle, peddlers. Placeholders: {name}, {other}, {place}; the peddler's ruin_tip also fills {dir}.

idle: Quiet out here.
Wind's picking up.
Long way from anywhere.
talk: Hm? Oh. Hello.
Didn't hear you land.
Mind your step out here.
storm: Sky's going bad. Get under something.
chat: Seen anything out past the ridge?

idle: Iron, iron, iron. There's gold in here somewhere. I can feel it.
Twelve years on rocks like this. My knees are worse than the rocks.
If you hear rumbling, it isn't me.
talk: Careful, that wall's loose.
Found a vein this morning. Not telling you where.
Got any water? I'll trade you a chunk of something shiny.
You here to dig, or to watch?
work: There's something in here. I can hear it.
attacked: Put that down! I've got nothing worth taking!
Hey! I swing a pick for a living!
barter_none: Haven't dug anything worth trading yet.
barter_done: The rest pays for the trip home.
storm: Storm's coming. I'm getting under the ledge.
Rocks don't mind the weather. I do.

idle: Don't lean over the edge. It doesn't give things back.
I mine in the morning and fish in the afternoon. Nobody bothers me in the afternoon.
fishing: Lava loops bite at shift change. Don't ask me how they know.
Normal line melts. Took me three rods to find that out.
Come on. I can see you down there.
talk: Hooked a bone once. Had a ring on it. Kept the ring.
If the ground starts glowing, walk the other way.
Pull up a rock. Not that one, it's hot.
catch: That's dinner. It's still hot. It's always still hot.
miss: Took the bait and half the hook.
cooking: About a minute on the stone. Less if you like it chewy.
Smells like a forge. Tastes better.
gift: Here. Eat that before it cools.
Take one. I've got more than I can eat.
work: The rock can wait. No, it can't.
One more wall, then back to the line.
attacked: Hey! I've got a pickaxe too!
storm: Ash is coming. Cover your face.
Wind's full of cinders. Get down.

idle: I row out, I sit, I row back. Best job in the galaxy.
Don't wave. It scares them.
fishing: They're running deep today. Deep and sulky.
Come on. I know you're hungry.
talk: Ahoy. Mind the rope.
Sharks came by an hour ago. Took one look at me and left. Rude.
Got a bucket of grumps if you're hungry. They taste like disappointment.
catch: Not bad. Not bad at all.
miss: Got away. They always get away.
sharks: Go on! Get! Nothing for you here!
gift: Take one. Plenty more down there.
attacked: Hey! What did I ever do to you?
storm: Storm's coming. You can see it on the water.
Swell's getting up. I'm heading in.

idle: Low and slow. That's the secret.
He was a trader. Now he's dinner.
cooking: Smells good, doesn't it? Nobody ever says no to the smell.
Needs more salt. Always needs more salt.
invite: Sit down. There's plenty. There's always plenty.
Don't be shy. Pull up a log.
warn: More meat walking in on its own. Lucky day.
Don't look at me like that. You eat meat too.
talk: Don't look at me like that. You eat meat too.
Sit down. There's plenty.
storm: Rain puts the fire out. I hate the rain.
Weather's turning. Help me cover the fire.

idle: The herd went east.
Wind's off the river. Good for hunting.
We move camp when the rains come.
talk: We saw you land. We see everything that lands.
Your ship is loud. You scared off the herd.
Leave the fruit. Take nothing from the trees.
warn: This is our ground. Walk around it.
Turn back. The poles mean what they mean.
trade_offer: You carry no spear. Sit. What do you trade?
A hide, or meat, and this is yours.
trade_done: It flies true. Look after it.
trade_refused: One spear is enough for your people.
chat: The river is low this year.
The strangers' ships come more often now.

conversations.opener: The herd came down to the river again.
replies: Good. The young ones are hungry.

conversations.opener: Another ship came down in the night.
replies: Let them come. They'll see the poles.

storm: Into the trees. Wait it out.

idle: Goods for sale! Nothing stolen, nothing cursed, nothing refunded.
Something's following us. Don't look. Keep smiling.
The pony carries the stock. I carry the conversation.
talk: Walked in from one ridge. Walking out the other.
Seen any settlements? No? Just you, then. You'll do.
Water, bandages, flares. Everything you forgot on the ship.
camp: Here's as good a spot as any. Come and look!
hawk: Last one of these I've got, friend.
ruin_tip: Old walls off to the {dir}. Nobody's lived there in a while. Something might still be in there.
Head {dir} and you'll find a ruin. Bring a light.
pack_lost: They got the pack! There's nothing left to sell!
My stock. All of it. On that poor animal.
ambush_over: Still breathing? Good. I remember a friend.
That was close. Thank you, truly.
farewell: Off I go. Mind the wildlife.
chat: We'll make the ridge by dark.

conversations.opener: You ever think about settling down somewhere?
replies: Every night. Then the sun comes up.
Where? It's all rocks and bugs.

idle: Keep moving.
Eyes open.
I don't like this stretch.
talk: Buying? Talk to the boss.
Keep your hands where I can see them.
ambush: Here they come! Watch the pack!
chat: Someone's been on this trail before us.
